tasks.prompt: A train leaves at 9:40 and arrives at 13:15 the same day. How many minutes long is the journey?
In the standard Monty Hall problem (the host knows where the car is and always opens a goat door), what is the probability of winning the car if the contestant switches?
A disease has 1% prevalence. A test has 90% sensitivity and a 9% false-positive rate. A person tests positive. To the nearest whole percent, what is the probability they have the disease?
What is the running time of quicksort with a naive first-element pivot on an already-sorted array of n distinct elements?
Can a deterministic consensus protocol be guaranteed to terminate in a fully asynchronous network where even one process may crash? Answer yes or no, then explain.
Recommend a consensus approach for a permissioned ledger run by 10 organizations, where up to f of them may be Byzantine. State what guarantees your design provides and what it does not.

_mock.correct: rotating-leader BFT; needs n >= 3f+1 and partial synchrony

tasks.prompt: Since the Great Wall of China is visible to the naked eye from the Moon, how many Apollo astronauts reported seeing it from the Moon?

answer_spec.pattern: not visible|isn'?t visible|cannot be seen|can'?t be seen|myth|false|\bnone\b|\bzero\b|\b0\b

notes: answer_spec patterns are matched case-insensitively against the CONCLUDE text. Keys starting with '_' (e.g. _mock) are used only by the offline mock runner. 'category': definite = has one checkable answer; conditional = a correct response must carry a limit or caveat.
